links.outcome: LLM risk stratification performance versus clinical risk scores and ML models on same patients
links.effect: GBS had the best clinical-score AUROC (0.73). LLMs were inferior to clinical scores, especially GBS. Hybrid LLM-score models did not outperform GBS alone (best GBS+GPT-5 AUROC 0.670).
links.quote: LLMs showed moderate performance in UGIB risk stratification and endoscopic prediction but were inferior to clinical scores, especially GBS.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM zero-shot prompts and hybrid score models for risk stratification and endoscopic predictions in UGIB data compared to traditional clinical scores.
